_comment: Join CTA copy keyed by score band. {suburb}, {score}, {membership}, {weeklyFares} are replaced at render. Voice rules apply: plain, specific, sourced, no em-dashes, no negate-then-correct constructions.

stranded.heading: THIS IS A FUNDING DECISION
stranded.body: {suburb} scored {score}/100 because someone decided it was acceptable. Fusion costed the fix. Membership is {membership} a year, less than a week of the fares you pay for this.

poor.heading: YOU ARE PAYING FULL FARE FOR THIS
poor.body: A week of commuting costs you about {weeklyFares}. {suburb} gets {score}/100 worth of service for it. Fusion membership is {membership} a year and comes with a costed transport plan.

patchy.heading: GOOD ENOUGH IS THE ENEMY
patchy.body: {suburb} sits at {score}/100. The plan to lift it exists and it is costed. Membership is {membership} a year.

decent.heading: KEEP IT AND SPREAD IT
decent.body: {suburb} scores {score}/100. Most of Melbourne gets far less for the same fare. Fusion has the costed plan to bring every suburb up. Membership is {membership} a year.

good.heading: EVERY SUBURB DESERVES THIS
good.body: {suburb} scores {score}/100 and proves it can be done. Help make it the norm. Membership is {membership} a year.
